$comment: #EXP-2172 (epic #EXP-2169; the approved CI redesign of session 64abb994, Danny 2026-11-27): THE CI PAGE x4 (view `ci`: web /ci, the desktop's CI screen, iOS and Android's CI destination; the phones' More menu entry), ONE ROOT row after Devices (sidebar-tree.json), across every member team. DATA, all synced: `ci_runs` + `ci_jobs` (our runs AND GitHub Actions runs, `provider` exponential | github; `title` = what the run is about: the head commit's first line, the PR's title, GitHub's display_title), `pull_requests`, the sessions shape (a root's starter), the users shape (a run's author = `createdByUserId`), repository full names, the devices shape (rows whose `runner.enabled` is true = the runners). `utcOffsetMinutes` = the viewer's clock offset (the day sections). STATUS TONES (`statusTones`, THE one table, also the run page's): passed ci-passed success, failed ci-failed danger, running ci-running INFO (blue, the only moving mark), queued ci-queued neutral, cancelled / skipped ci-skipped neutral (muted text, never struck through). A run's status = ci-run.json `runStatus` over its jobs; source = `github` for provider github, else `exponential`; `mine` = the viewer started it or its PR's root session is the viewer's. RUNS (`ciRunList`, `ciRunGroups`): newest first by startedAt (else createdAt), ties by id, at most `limits.runs`, filtered by status All | Running (running + queued) | Failed | Mine, a repository (`ciRepoOptions`) and a source. A ROW (`ciRunRow`): title = the run's `title`, else a pending merge train run's batch (copy.batchTitle over the repo's testing PRs' numbers), else its PR's title, else the pipeline's name; workflow = `name #n`; repo = the full name's last segment (copy.unknownRepository while unknown); subtitle (wide) = workflow · repo · ref · sha7 · trigger (copy.pullRequest with the PR's number for a pull request run whose PR is known, else copy.triggers[trigger], unknown = raw); phoneSubtitle = repo · ref · workflow; duration = pr-checks formatDuration of (completedAt or now) - startedAt, null before it started; phoneMeta = the duration, else copy.queued; wide trailing = `duration · age` (else `copy.waitingForRunner · age`; the age = the catalog's formatRelativeTime of `at`), the source mark, the author's avatar; `at` = startedAt else createdAt (the age, drawn relative); sourceIcon github | brand-exponential (its tooltip = sourceLabel); author = the users row of createdByUserId (an avatar), null when none. SECTIONS (`ciRunGroups`): In progress (copy.inProgress with the count: running + queued) first, then one per LOCAL day of `at` (`ciDayTitle`: copy.today, copy.yesterday, else `d Mon` from copy.months, + ` yyyy` when not this year). A running merge train run sits in In progress; the train's detail is the Merge train tab. RUNNER CHIP (`ciRunnerChip`): copy.runnerChip over runners online (lastSeenAt younger than `limits.runnerOnlineMs`) of all, a green dot while one is online; none without runners; a press opens the Runners tab. THE BADGE (nav-badges.json destination `ci`, `ciBadge`): the viewer's runs, the NEWEST per (repository, pipeline name, ref): failed ones = that count, `attention` (a green re-run clears it); else the running or queued ones, `muted`; else none. MERGE TRAIN TAB (`ciTrainGroups(input, true)`): per repository (by name; caption = the PRs' base) its testing batches (one row each: the first member's `#n`, the PR's title alone or copy.train.batch with {count}, the members `#n title` joined by ` · `, glyph ci-running, badge merge-train.json copy.pill.testing), the queued PRs by mergePosition (copy.pill.queuedAt with its `ordinal`, glyph ci-queued), then the waiting ones by number (copy.pill checksRunning | onHold | conflict | failing; glyph ci-queued for checks, ci-skipped for held, else ci-failed); a row opens its PR. RUNNERS TAB (`ciRunnerRows`): online first, then by name; subtitle = runner-settings.json `runnerOsLabel` then its own labels lower-cased (copy.runners.noLabels when none); busy = copy.runners.busy (online only); queue = copy.runners.queue over OUR queued, undispatched jobs whose runsOn it covers (null when none); offlineSince = its lastSeenAt while offline (the catalog's `fill` of copy.runners.offlineSince with `formatRelativeTime`). No lanes. TAB COUNTS (`ciTabCounts`): Merge train = its rows, Runners = the runners. LAYOUT node for node: ci-page-view.json (reference apps/web/src/lib/ci-page-view.ts). Replayed by packages/domain-contract (bun test), desktop domain::ci_page, iOS ExpCore CiPage, Android domain/CiPage.kt over every case, comparing the WHOLE result.
